projecthero.super_soldier.ability.combo_: R: three fast punches on the enemy in front of you (7, 7, then a 9-damage finisher that knocks it back). Needs a target within 4 blocks. 5s cooldown.
projecthero.super_soldier.ability.shield: C: throw the shield in your hand. It bounces from enemy to enemy, then flies back to you. Adamantium Shield: 9 per hit, up to 4 enemies. Vibranium Shield: 10 per hit, up to 5. Any other shield: 8 per hit, up to 3 enemies. All fly at least 25 blocks. No cooldown: throw it again as soon as it is back in your hand.
projecthero.super_soldier.ability.leapin: Z: leap 4 blocks up and forward, then drive down into the ground: 10 damage to everything within 5 blocks (less at the edge), knocked back and up. No fall damage. 12s cooldown.
projecthero.super_soldier.ability.onslau: Shift+Z, ULTIMATE: a shockwave (20 damage at the centre, 6 blocks), then 10s of +2 melee damage, Resistance I, Speed I and +25% damage on every move. Every punch shocks enemies within 3 blocks of the target for 7. 100s cooldown. No hit goes over 20.
projecthero.guide.super_soldier.passives: +50% movement speed, +5 hearts, +7 melee damage bare-handed (+2 holding a weapon), 30% less damage taken, a 2-block jump and a longer safe fall, 20% knockback resistance, +15% attack speed, healing out of combat, and immunity to Poison and Nausea.
projecthero.super_soldier.ability.flying: G: launch yourself feet-first at the enemy in front of you (up to 8 blocks away) for 10 damage and a big knockback, then spring back off it. No fall damage. 8s cooldown.
projecthero.super_soldier.ability.judo_t: Shift+G: grab the enemy in front of you (3.5 blocks), heave it over your shoulder and slam it into the ground behind you: 10 damage and stunned for 1.5s. Bosses are too big to throw but still take the hit. 10s cooldown.
item.projecthero.vibranium_shield.desc2: Super Soldier C throw: 10 damage, 5 bounces, 30 blocks.
